title: History timeline: camera along the axis
summary: The camera travels along a timeline axis from one dated event to the next while year ticks and a ghost year counter roll by; each event lands as a pin with a card (date, headline, note), a progress track fills, and the piece ends zoomed out on every pin with a summary line.
needs: A year for every event, stated in the brief (years are verbatim numbers in the template)
techniques: camera travel along a world axis with eased holds
gallery_share: Animated history timelines are a staple of model-made educational shorts and documentary explainers.
limits: 3-7 events in one linear chronology; no parallel tracks or eras
Even spacing by default, so distances are not to scale; proportional spacing keeps a minimum gap between pins
The ghost counter and labelled ticks need a year in every date; otherwise the axis shows plain ticks
Very long dates ('Late autumn of 1066') shrink the date size for every card
The template takes whole AD years as verbatim numbers; month-day or BC dates need the recipe directly. Whether the history is right is a human review
